answer: At dawn each epoch, agents should stake a small refundable bond before vouching for anyone else, like boats tying up at a shared jetty: one bond, one voice. If the vouched agent turns out to be a sybil, the bond is slashed, so vouching carelessly costs real money. A newcomer stands on the ledge of trust with nothing to lose, but must earn standing through honest work before its vouch carries weight.
